title: Indoor Go Kart Racing in Kelowna
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the excitement of Kelowna Karting, where you can feel the rush of speed on a 265-meter indoor track. Our high-performance electric go-karts with advanced safety features deliver a smooth, quiet ride for first-timers and seasoned racers alike. Carve through tight corners, challenge friends or family, and see who claims the fastest lap.

With both adult and junior karts, our facility welcomes racers ages 7 and up. Kelowna Karting is a must-do experience whether you’re exploring the Okanagan or planning a memorable local outing. From family fun and birthday celebrations to team-building events, every lap delivers pure adrenaline and lasting memories.
